plan.title: Create Single-Stage RFP from Material PR

steps.note: Enable eRFX project creation as required by the case.
Allow vendors to be added during event creation and keep Publish available.
Provide the required event title so the event can be published and found afterward.
Verify that the RFP create screen does not show a pricing column.
Verify the transferred PR quantity is shown on the create screen.
Verify the transferred PR unit is shown on the create screen.
Add the two vendors named in the case.
Commit the requested Start now, 30-minute schedule.
Verify that publishing reached a real project page.
Return to the event page for the post-publish menu assertion.
Verify that an event created from a PR cannot use Recreate Order.
Confirm the In Progress view is available after publishing the event.
